links.comparator_used: Standalone models-only SVM inference pipeline without surgeon HITL correction
links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity for glioma detection
links.effect: HITL using segmentation maps: Accuracy 94% [95% CI: 88-98%], Sensitivity 98% [95% CI: 92-100%]; SVM baseline: Accuracy 84% [95% CI: 81-87%], Sensitivity 83% [95% CI: 78-88%].
links.quote: Compared to the standalone models, the HITL approach significantly outperformed the SVM baseline (Accuracy 84% [95% CI: 81-87%]; Sensitivity 83% [95% CI: 78-88%]).
